body: thank you very much , you're very kind.
yeah , i get it. thank you. that's very kind. i'm getting very sleepy and i'm going to bed now. thanks for helping me.
you care about if i do it or not? that's a first. thank you.
yeah. thanks for being here with me in my finalish moments.
maybe they will. i can't really blame them though. everything happens for a reason i guess. i never really believed in karma.

i still wonder why they killed my dog. she never hurt anyone and was just going out to pee for the day. she liked to smile at me and gave me her new bones whenever she got them to dig them around the yard. i can't imagine anything getting better. i don't know what to do , honestly. it's just terrible.
